## Appearance

Cressy Lindsay has the delicate, ethereal appearance of a fairy. She is characterized by her large brown eyes and a lopsided smile.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P3](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0003), [v3 ch.Weddings P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Cressy Lindsay possesses a loyal nature and is completely free from snobbery or selfishness, though she can be somewhat thoughtless. She prefers to avoid thinking about broken hearts or any other disagreeable topics. Mathematically talented, she earned Honors in Mathematics, and she is also skilled with her hands—capable of dressmaking—as well as proficient at shopping, cleaning dishes, and sweeping floors. Her primary ambition is to secure a marriage proposal from Mr. Hale ([Ezra](../character/ezra.md)). Additionally, she despises green Christmases and harbors a severe fear of scarlet fever.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P52](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0052), [v3 ch.Place P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065), [v3 ch.Relationships P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066), [v3 ch.Robin P2](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0002), [v3 ch.Speaks P3](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0003), +4 more_

## History

Descended from an elite and established [Bluenose](../codex/factions.md#bluenose) lineage, Cressida "Cressy" Lindsay first met [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) at [Old St](../codex/places.md#old-st). John's Cemetery while attending [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), and the trio quickly established a warm friendship. Cressy used her social influence to aid her friends, and after enthusiastically begging to join them as a housemate, she moved into Tabby's Place for their remaining college years. During her time at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), she frequently discussed her various potential suitors and potential marriage with her housemates. While staying at a boardinghouse in [Prospect Point](../codex/places.md#prospect-point), Cressy developed feelings for a young theology student named [Ezra](../character/ezra.md) [Hale](../character/ezra.md), eventually accepting his marriage proposal. She remained a close confidante to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) throughout their studies, offering comfort and advice during Nell's various romantic troubles. After graduating and marrying [Ezra](../character/ezra.md), Cressy later gave birth to infants.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P11](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0011), [v3 ch.Lady P19](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0019), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), +31 more_

## Quotes

> "No, no, my dear. Shyness is not one of the numerous faults—or good qualities—possessed by Cressida Lindsay—Cressy as a nickname. Please use Cressy for me from the start. Well then, what are your names?"
>
> — Cressy Lindsay — [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)

> "Provided I am able to stroll alongside Honora and Wilfred, I will attend. Such an arrangement will render the chaperone role tolerable. Your Hugh is genuinely wonderful, Nell, yet what prompts his frequent company with Goggle-eyes?"
>
> — Cressy Lindsay — [v3 ch.Park P9](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0009)

> "See—encircling the archway above the gate, written in white lettering. ‘Tabby’s Place.’ Isn’t that hilarious? Particularly along this Avenue filled with Pinehursts, Elmwolds, and Cedarcrofts? ‘Tabby’s Place,’ no less! I absolutely love it."
>
> — Cressy Lindsay — [v3 ch.Park P34](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0034)

> "It’s true that they are exceptionally sweet boys, you know. An abundance of dances, drives, and overall festivities is planned. For failing to return home alongside me during the break, Queen Nell, you will never have my forgiveness."
>
> — Cressy Lindsay — [v3 ch.Again P2](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0002)

> "I imagine a couple of quilting bees will take place; additionally, every old busybody will discuss you, both directly and in your absence. My dear, boredom will be the death of you."
>
> — Cressy Lindsay — [v3 ch.Again P4](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0004)
